title: Hurricane Laura: ROE first step in Blue Roof program
description: Homeowners in SW Lousiana whose roofs were damaged by Hurricane Laura have one more week to apply for support from Operation Blue Roof. Michelle Thomason, U.S. Army Engineer Research and Development Center (ERDC), talks about the first step, granting right of entry access, and how to sign up. Operation Blue Roof is a priority mission managed by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers for FEMA Federal Emergency Management Agency.
